scope: Research software, protocols, frozen scientific summaries, manuscript and supplement.
source_text_encoding: Committed bytes; maintained text uses UTF-8 and LF.

tests.skip_reason: Original CF real-data target matrix is not redistributed.

notes: Independent Git history; no dependency on the development repository.

Input datasets, model weights, course presentations and site-specific execution files are excluded.
artifact_source_scope: Source and release content used for the PDFs and validation; later provenance-only commits do not alter those artifacts.
